verdict.rationale: Fellow's automation surface consists of webhooks and a REST API, where the integrator supplies all the action logic. The evidence states that no in-product rules engine is documented, and nothing shows versioning, review, or rollback of automations. API path versioning (/api/v1) and Fellow Markdown round-tripping are adjacent features, not automation version control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
